image_description: A low-angle shot of a maypole against a blue sky with clouds. The pole is topped with a red and gold star-shaped finial. Multiple colorful ribbons (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, pink, white) extend from the top downwards in a radial pattern. A watermark '© Sienna Wildfield' is visible in the bottom right corner.

The convergence of ribbons at the star finial lacks clear mechanical attachment logic; they seem to merge slightly into the background of the star rather than being distinctly tied or clipped.
